title: Automātiskas figurālo alumīnija konservu kārbu aizvākošanas iekārtas iegāde
description: Vienas jaunas automātiskas figurālo alumīnija konservu kārbu aizvākošanas iekārtas iegāde, piegāde, uzstādīšana, nodošana ekspluatācijā un personāla apmācība. Iekārta paredzēta figurālo alumīnija zivju konservu kārbu hermētiskai aizvākošanai, nodrošinot ražību ne mazāku par 90 kārbām minūtē. Iekārtai jānodrošina divu kārbu formātu aizvākošana – 105 × 76 × 21,25 mm un 105 × 76 × 25,1 mm. Detalizētas tehniskās prasības un piegādes nosacījumi noteikti iepirkuma dokumentācijā. Iepirkums tiek veikts Lauku atbalsta dienesta (LAD) projekta “Zivju konservu ražošanas procesu modernizācija un automatizācija” ietvaros.

description: Air Force Research Laboratory (AFRL) Request for Information for High Hypersonic Reentry Flight Experiment Program Introduction Air Force Research Laboratory (AFRL) is gathering information for future partnering with industry and other government agencies to develop high-cadence, recoverable, reliable, cost-effective orbital and hypersonic reentry experiment platforms. These platforms offer exposure to extreme reentry environments with payload recovery post-fight for Technology Readiness Level (TRL) maturation and Science & Technology (S&T) advancement. title: Germany – Pharmaceutical products – Abschluss nicht exkl. Arzneimittel-Rabattvereinb. nach § 130a Abs. 8 SGB V im Wege eines Open-House-Modells zum Wirkstoff Epoetin zeta (rekombinantes humanes Erythropoetin)
description: Gegenstand dieser Veröffentlichung ist der Abschluss nicht exklusiver Rabattvereinbarungen nach § 130a Abs. 8 SGB V über Arzneimittel mit dem Wirkstoff Epoetin zeta (rekombinantes humanes Erythropoetin). Der Vertragsabschluss erfolgt im Rahmen eines sog. Open-House-Modells, d. h. ein Vertragsabschluss steht innerhalb des Teilnahmezeitraums allen interessierten pharmazeutischen Unternehmen offen, sofern diese die Teilnahmevoraussetzungen erfüllen und akzeptieren. Dies hat zur Folge, dass individuelle Vertragsverhandlungen nicht geführt werden und eine (Liefer-)Exklusivität nicht gegeben ist. Es wird darauf hingewiesen, dass die Abnahmemenge unbekannt ist, da diese von der Nachfrage und der Entwicklung der Versichertenzahl, von dem Verordnungsverhalten der Ärzte sowie dem Abgabe- und Bevorratungsverhalten der öffentlichen Apotheken abhängig ist. Mindestabnahmemengen werden demensprechend nicht garantiert. Interessierte pharmazeutische Unternehmer können die Teilnahmeunterlagen über den Projektraum des Deutschen Vergabeportals (DTVP) herunterladen. Dazu ist zunächst ein Antrag auf Zugang zum Projektraum erforderlich. Nach erfolgter Freischaltung durch die Auftraggeberin kann anschließend auf die Teilnahmeunterlagen zugegriffen werden. Über den Inhalt der Teilnahmeunterlagen - insbesondere über den Inhalt der Rabattvereinbarung und den dort genannten Rabatten - ist absolutes Stillschweigen zu bewahren. Eine vollständige oder teilweise Weitergabe oder Zugänglichmachung von Inhalten der Teilnahmeunterlagen an bzw. für Dritte bedarf der vorherigen schriftlichen Zustimmung der Auftraggeberin. Sofern von einer Teilnahme abgesehen wird, sind alle Unterlagen unverzüglich datenschutzgerecht zu vernichten. Die einzureichenden Unterlagen ergeben sich aus den im Projektraum hinterlegten Dokumenten "Anschreiben" und "Erläuterungen der Vertragsbedingungen". Die Kommunikation, einschließlich der Übermittlung der Teilnahmeunterlagen, erfolgt elektronisch über das Vergabeportal DTVP; Einzelheiten hierzu sind den zuvor genannten Dokumenten zu entnehmen. Etwaige anderslautende Angaben in der Auftragsbekanntmachung sind technischen Gründen geschuldet und beanspruchen keine Verbindlichkeit. Teilnahmeanträge können erstmals bis zum 05.05.2025 eingereicht werden. Alle weiteren Einreichungsfristen entnehmen Sie bitte der im Projektraum hinterlegten Anlage "Einreichungsfristen". Fällt der Tag der Einreichungsfrist auf einen Sonnabend, Sonntag oder bundesweit gesetzlichen Feiertag, so tritt an die Stelle eines solchen Tages der nächste Werktag. Bei verspätetem Zugang werden die eingereichten Teilnahmeanträge zur nächsten Einreichungsfrist berücksichtigt. Die Rabattvereinbarung endet, unabhängig vom Datum des Vertragsschlusses, spätestens zum 30.04.2027. Die Auftraggeberin behält sich vor, das Open-House-Verfahren vorzeitig zu beenden, insbesondere im Falle des Abschlusses exklusiver Rabattvereinbarungen; in diesem Fall enden die bereits geschlossenen Rabattvereinbarungen nach Maßgabe der vertraglichen Bestimmungen. Den Erfahrungen der Auftraggeberin nach treten exklusive Rabattvereinbarungen in der Regel 8 bis 12 Monate nach der Veröffentlichung der entsprechenden Auftragsbekanntmachung im Supplement zum Amtsblatt der Europäischen Union in Kraft.

Der Vertragsabschluss erfolgt im Rahmen eines sog. Open-House-Modells, d. h. ein Vertragsabschluss steht innerhalb des Teilnahmezeitraums allen interessierten pharmazeutischen Unternehmen offen, sofern diese die Teilnahmevoraussetzungen erfüllen und akzeptieren. Dies hat zur Folge, dass individuelle Vertragsverhandlungen nicht geführt werden und eine (Liefer-)Exklusivität nicht gegeben ist. Es wird darauf hingewiesen, dass die Abnahmemenge unbekannt ist, da diese von der Nachfrage und der Entwicklung der Versichertenzahl, von dem Verordnungsverhalten der Ärzte sowie dem Abgabe- und Bevorratungsverhalten der öffentlichen Apotheken abhängig ist. Mindestabnahmemengen werden demensprechend nicht garantiert. Interessierte pharmazeutische Unternehmer können die Teilnahmeunterlagen über den Projektraum des Deutschen Vergabeportals (DTVP) herunterladen. Dazu ist zunächst ein Antrag auf Zugang zum Projektraum erforderlich. Nach erfolgter Freischaltung durch die Auftraggeberin kann anschließend auf die Teilnahmeunterlagen zugegriffen werden. Über den Inhalt der Teilnahmeunterlagen - insbesondere über den Inhalt der Rabattvereinbarung und den dort genannten Rabatten - ist absolutes Stillschweigen zu bewahren. Eine vollständige oder teilweise Weitergabe oder Zugänglichmachung von Inhalten der Teilnahmeunterlagen an bzw. für Dritte bedarf der vorherigen schriftlichen Zustimmung der Auftraggeberin. Sofern von einer Teilnahme abgesehen wird, sind alle Unterlagen unverzüglich datenschutzgerecht zu vernichten. Die einzureichenden Unterlagen ergeben sich aus den im Projektraum hinterlegten Dokumenten "Anschreiben" und "Erläuterungen der Vertragsbedingungen". Die Kommunikation, einschließlich der Übermittlung der Teilnahmeunterlagen, erfolgt elektronisch über das Vergabeportal DTVP; Einzelheiten hierzu sind den zuvor genannten Dokumenten zu entnehmen. Etwaige anderslautende Angaben in der Auftragsbekanntmachung sind technischen Gründen geschuldet und beanspruchen keine Verbindlichkeit. Teilnahmeanträge können erstmals bis zum 02.04.2025 eingereicht werden. Alle weiteren Einreichungsfristen entnehmen Sie bitte der im Projektraum hinterlegten Anlage "Einreichungsfristen". Fällt der Tag der Einreichungsfrist auf einen Sonnabend, Sonntag oder bundesweit gesetzlichen Feiertag, so tritt an die Stelle eines solchen Tages der nächste Werktag. Bei verspätetem Zugang werden die eingereichten Teilnahmeanträge zur nächsten Einreichungsfrist berücksichtigt. Die Rabattvereinbarung endet, unabhängig vom Datum des Vertragsschlusses, spätestens zum 30.04.2027. Die Auftraggeberin behält sich vor, das Open-House-Verfahren vorzeitig zu beenden, insbesondere im Falle des Abschlusses exklusiver Rabattvereinbarungen; in diesem Fall enden die bereits geschlossenen Rabattvereinbarungen nach Maßgabe der vertraglichen Bestimmungen. Den Erfahrungen der Auftraggeberin nach treten exklusive Rabattvereinbarungen in der Regel 8 bis 12 Monate nach der Veröffentlichung der entsprechenden Auftragsbekanntmachung im Supplement zum Amtsblatt der Europäischen Union in Kraft.

title: Request for Information (RFI) - Local Construction Subcontractors for Spangdahlem AB MACC
description: 1.0 DESCRIPTION The 52nd Contracting Squadron (52 CONS) at Spangdahlem Air Base, Germany, is issuing this Request for Information (RFI) to conduct market research. The Government is seeking to identify qualified local construction companies interested in serving as subcontractors to our existing Multiple Award Construction Contract (MACC) prime contractors. BLUF: The Government is seeking local tradespeople available to support ongoing base infrastructure projects. The information gathered from this RFI will be compiled into a vendor directory and provided to our current MACC prime contractors to facilitate teaming arrangements and subcontracting opportunities. DISCLAIMER: This is an RFI only. This is NOT a Request for Proposal (RFP), Request for Quotation (RFQ), or an Invitation for Bid (IFB). This notice does not constitute a commitment by the United States Government to issue a contract, nor does it restrict the Government to a particular acquisition approach. The Government will not reimburse any costs associated with responding to this RFI. 2.0 SCOPE OF WORK & DISCIPLINES REQUIRED The Spangdahlem MACC encompasses a broad range of maintenance, repair, and new construction work. We are seeking subcontractors capable of performing work across all construction trades. Areas of interest include, but are not limited to: General Construction & Carpentry Electrical (High and Low Voltage) Plumbing & Pipefitting Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC) Roofing (Commercial and Industrial) Concrete, Masonry, and Paving Civil & Site Work (Excavation, Grading) Painting and specialized coatings Fire Protection & Suppression Systems Environmental Remediation & Abatement (e.g., Asbestos, Lead) Mandatory Requirement: All interested firms must possess the appropriate and current German trade certifications (e.g., Meisterbrief or equivalent recognized qualifications) required to legally perform their specific trades in Germany. 3.0 REQUESTED INFORMATION Interested companies are requested to submit a brief Capability Statement (no more than 5 pages). Please format your response to include the following information: Company Profile: Company Name and Address Point of Contact (Name, Title, Phone, Email) NCAGE Code and Unique Entity ID (UEI) (if applicable/registered in SAM.gov) Trade Capabilities & Certifications: A list of the specific construction trades your company performs. Verification of German trade certifications/licenses held by your firm or personnel. Experience: A brief summary of your company's experience in the commercial or industrial construction sector. Specify if you have prior experience working on U.S. military installations or with the U.S. Government (Note: Prior U.S. Government experience is not a requirement to respond). Capacity & Geographic Reach: Confirmation of your company's ability to commute to and perform work at Spangdahlem Air Base. Typical project size (in Euros or USD) your company is capable of bonding or managing. Consent to Share: An explicit statement authorizing 52 CONS to share your company's contact information and capabilities with our current MACC prime contractors. 4.0 SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS Responses to this RFI must be submitted via email no later than 30 April 2027 1600 Central European Summer Time (CEST). Please submit all capability statements and inquiries to: Contracting Officer: Kimberly Ng Brown at Email: kimberly.ng_brown@us.af.mil / Anja Weber-Sabo at Email: anja.weber-sabo.1.de@us.af.mil

title: DARPA's Commercial Solutions Opening (DCSO) for Commercial Strategy
description: The Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency�s (DARPA) mission is to create technological surprise for national security, driving its research and development (R&D) programs to transform revolutionary concepts into practical capabilities for the military and civilian society. Under DARPA�s Commercial Solutions Opening (DCSO), DARPA seeks to close military and civilian capability gaps with commercial solutions derived from the Agency�s R&D programs. This DCSO is issued by DARPA Commercial Strategy within the Director�s Office. The Commercial Strategy team oversees the implementation of the DCSO, which includes the Embedded Entrepreneurship Initiative (EEI). The EEI, through the DCSO, awards participants with funds to support the integration of an embedded entrepreneur (EE) to assist performers with commercialization and business development efforts. Proposals submitted under this DCSO are solicited for transitioning and commercializing innovative solutions derived from DARPA-funded technologies into capabilities that meet operational requirements, close capability gaps, or deliver new technological advancements. DARPA anticipates receiving a range of proposals reflecting diverse technical, scientific, and business approaches.

Netherlands – Supply services of personnel including temporary staff – Instellen van een tijdelijke DAS t.b.v. inhuur extern personeel
description: Door Hoogheemraadschap De Stichtse Rijnlanden (HDSR) wordt een tijdelijke DAS ingesteld. Voor de uitvoering van de DAS wordt het digitale platform van www.flextender.nl ingezet. Via deze website kunnen partijen zich aanmelden voor de DAS. Flextender controleert nieuwe aanmeldingen op de daarvoor gestelde eisen, waaronder akkoord inschrijfvoorwaarden FLX 2026, AWVODI-2018 en verklaring UEA. Alle nadere inhuuruitvragen van HDSR worden op de website van Flextender gepubliceerd. Onderhavige DAS gaat in vanaf publicatie van onderhavige aankondiging (april 2026) en loopt tot uiterlijk 1 mei 2027. HDSR bereidt op dit moment voor een nieuwe Europese aanbesteding voor de lange termijn omtrent inhuur van derden. De inhuren uit onderhavige DAS gaan per eerst mogelijke verlenging over naar de nieuwe contractant zodra deze overeenkomst is ingegaan. Alle inhuren die per 1 mei 2027 nog via Flextender lopen, gaan per die datum over naar de nieuwe contractant. Gemiddeld zet HDSR 75 inhuuruitvragen per jaar uit. Aan dit aantal kunnen volledig geen rechten ontleend worden. We stellen deze DAS in met inachtneming van alle andere raamovereenkomsten van HDSR. De scope van deze overeenkomsten blijft ongewijzigd ongeacht het instellen van deze DAS.

title: Tampereen harrastamisen malli
description: Tampereen kaupungin Lupa liikkua ja Lupa harrastaa -toiminta on osa valtakunnallista Harrastamisen Suomen mallia, jonka tavoite on tarjota peruskoululaisille (1.lk – 9.lk) laadukkaita, mieluisia ja maksuttomia harrastusmahdollisuuksia oman koulun ja kodin läheisyydessä, lasten toiveita kuullen. Harrastusten järjestäjinä voi toimia urheiluseuroja, yksittäisiä taiteilijoita ja taidekasvattajia, ammattimaisia taide-, kulttuuri-, ja liikuntatoimijoita sekä muita ammattimaisia toimijoita. Harrastustoiminta on koko lukuvuoden kestävää toimintaa, joka alkaa syyskuussa ja loppuu toukokuussa. Tampereen kaupunki tulee kilpailuttamaan lapsille ja nuorille suunnatun harrastustoiminnan järjestämisen aikajaksolle syyskuu 2023 - kesäkuu 2028 osana Harrastamisen Suomen malli -hanketta. Tämän ajanjakson aikana julkaistaan useampia tarjouspyyntöjä. Kilpailutukset toteutetaan nyt perustettavan dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän puitteissa. Dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä on kaksivaiheinen. Ensimmäisessä vaiheessa dynaamisessa hankintajärjestelmässä ilmoittaudutaan mukaan ko. järjestelmään ja siinä tarkistetaan ehdokkaan soveltuvuus ja toisessa vaiheessa ehdokkaat voivat antaa tarjouksia tarjouskilpailuihin, jotka järjestetään DPS järjestelmän sisällä. Kaikki kelpoisuus- ja vähimmäisvaatimukset täyttävät toimittajat valitaan mukaan DPS:sään. Hankintajärjestelmä sisältää kolme erillistä osa-aluetta: 1) liikunnallinen harrastustoiminta, 2) kulttuurinen, digitaalinen ja muu harrastustoiminta, 3) erityislapsille suunnattu harrastustoiminta., Osa-alue 1. Liikunnallinen harrastustoiminta Osa-alueen 1 hankintojen kohteena ovat lapsille ja nuorille suunnatut liikunnalliset harrastustoimintapalvelut. Osa-alueen harrastustoiminnan ohjauskerta voi koskea esimerkiksi seuraavia harrastuksia: Pallo- ja mailapelit, tanssi, voimistelu ja cheerleading, kamppailu- ja voimailulajit, kiipeily, skeittaus, keilaaminen, uinti, frisbeegolf, lumilautailu, jäälajit, jooga. Hankintayksikkö voi kilpailuttaa tässä osa-alueessa myös muuta näihin verrattavissa olevan liikunnallisen harrastustoiminnan ohjaustunteja., Osa-alue 2. Kulttuurinen, digitaalinen ja muu harrastustoiminta Osa-alueen 2 hankintojen kohteena ovat lapsille ja nuorille suunnatut kulttuuriset, digitaaliset ja muut harrastustoimintapalvelut. Osa-alueen harrastustoiminnan ohjauskerta voi koskea esimerkiksi seuraavia harrastuksia: Kuva– ja mediataide, elokuva, musiikki, kirjallisuus ja lukeminen, muotoilu, arkkitehtuuri, kädentaidot, teatteri, pelit ja koodaus, ruuanvalmistus, eläin- ja luontoharrastus, tiede ja historia. Hankintayksikkö voi kilpailuttaa tässä osa-alueessa myös muuta näihin verrattavissa olevan kulttuurisen, digitaalisen ja muun harrastustoiminnan ohjaustunteja., Osa-alue 3. Erityislapsille suunnattu harrastustoiminta Osa-alueen 3 hankintojen kohteena ovat erityislapsille suunnatut harrastustoimintapalvelut. Osa-alueen harrastustoiminnan ohjauskerta voi koskea esimerkiksi seuraavia harrastuksia: erityislapsille soveltuvat liikunta-, kulttuuri-, taide ja muu lasten- ja nuorten harrastustoiminta laajasti.,

Първоначално планиранираният спектър може да бъде частично изменен, както и да се добавят нови продукти в хода на динамичната система. Количествата са ориентировъчни. Възложителят не e длъжен да изкупи посочените в спектъра количества. Одобрените кандидати могат да подадат оферта за една или повече единици, както и могат да не подадат оферта. ДСП функционира на два етапа: Първи етап - събиране на заявления за участие и Втори етап - събиране на оферти по конкретни покани. Разглеждането на първоначалните заявления за участие ще се извърши в срок до 15 работни дни от крайният срок за подаване на заявления. Покана за конкретна поръчка няма да бъде обявявана преди да бъдат разгледани всички заявления. Офертите ще бъдат класирани от програма, която ще е достъпна и безплатна за всички кандидати. Осигурен е неограничен, пълен и пряк достъп до документацията за обществената поръчка през целия срок на действие на ДСП. ДСП ще функционира в рамките на три години, а именно в рамките на три години възложителят може да отправя покани до допуснатите кандидати за събиране на оферти за доставка на медицински изделия включени в първоначално планираният спектър или извън него. Слючените договори ще са със срок на действие: две години.

description: Please note this solicitation is not ready to be issued as of this date. The Embassy of the United States in Rome, Italy will launch the solicitation on the SAM.gov website when it is available. The solicitation covers the replacement of air conditioning systems serving three IT rooms located within the Embassy compound in Rome, Italy. The Contractor shall furnish labor, material, and equipment to perform the work as required in the contract. This project is estimated at between $100,000 and $250,000. All responsible sources may submit a quotation, which will be considered. The Government may award the contract based on the initial offer without discussion. The resultant contract will be a firm fixed price type contract. The Government is planning a pre-quotation conference and a site visit. The date for this conference and site visit will be in the solicitation. All contractors must be registered in the SAM (System for Award Management) Database https://www.sam.gov prior to submitting an offer pursuant to FAR provision 52.204-7. Therefore, prospective offerors are encouraged to register prior to the submittal of quotation. Electronic Submission/Responses: This opportunity allows for electronic responses. Please submit your quotation prior to the response date and time. Please ensure your email with your offer does not exceed 25MB, if it does then you might have to send more than one email.

title: Norway – Jetties – Vardø fishing port - outer pier
description: The Norwegian Coastal Administration (NCA) is a government agency under the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Fisheries. The agency is responsible for ensuring safe and efficient maritime traffic along the Norwegian coast and into ports, and for maintaining the national preparedness and response system for acute pollution incidents. The NCA is responsible for the safety and navigability of Norway’s coastal waters. Its responsibilities include navigation infrastructure, state-owned fishing harbour facilities, fairway development measures, pilotage services, and vessel traffic services (VTS). The NCA is also responsible for Norway’s national emergency preparedness and response to acute pollution incidents. In addition, the NCA participates in planning processes and exercises regulatory authority under the Ports and Fairways Act, parts of the Pollution Control Act, the Svalbard Environmental Protection Act, and the Planning and Building Act. The agency also contributes to the preparation of the National Transport Plan, which is presented every four years and covers all four transport sectors: road, rail, air, and maritime transport. The NCA is organised into four business areas: Ports, Fairways and Coastal Transport Navigation Technology and Maritime Services Emergency Response to Acute Pollution Pilotage Services Vardø Fishing Harbour is the largest fishing harbour in the Municipality of Vardø and an important base for the fishing fleet operating in Eastern Finnmark. The harbour is exposed to significant wave action from the northwest through northeast sectors, resulting in challenging berthing conditions, an increased risk of damage to vessels and infrastructure, and limitations on the efficient use of the harbour facilities. The project comprises the construction of a new outer breakwater north of the entrance to Vardø Harbour, together with dredging and deepening works at Hasselneset to maintain adequate navigational access after the harbour entrance is narrowed by the new breakwater. The breakwater will have a total length of approximately 660 metres and will be constructed in water depths of up to 35 metres. The deepening works at Hasselneset include both dredging of unconsolidated seabed sediments and underwater rock blasting, with a total excavation volume of approximately 45,000 m³. Material excavated during the deepening works will be reused in the breakwater construction where feasible. A substantial portion of the works will be carried out from the sea using a temporary offshore construction platform. All imported rock material for the breakwater construction will be transported by sea. The project therefore relies heavily on marine-based logistics, specialised marine equipment, and execution under demanding weather and wave conditions. The project is subject to extensive environmental requirements and numerous regulatory permits, including those relating to marine construction activities, dredging, underwater blasting, environmental monitoring, and plastic waste management. In addition, seasonal restrictions apply to certain construction activities. The primary objective of the project is to improve shelter and operational safety within Vardø Fishing Harbour, facilitate efficient and reliable harbour operations, and support the continued development of fisheries and other maritime industries in the region.

title: Bulgaria – Baby food – Доставка на адаптирани млека за новородени деца за срок от 24 месеца
description: Настоящата динамична система за покупки се създава за период от 24 месеца с цел обезпечаване на доставки на адаптирани млека за новородени деца за нуждите на „СБАЛАГ - Майчин дом" ЕАД. В рамките на период на действие на динамичната система за покупки (ДСП) ще бъдат възлагани обществени поръчки чрез ограничени процедури за периодични доставки на адаптирани млека за новородени. Срокът на договорите, сключвани въз основа на ограничените процедури в рамките на ДСП е за период от 12 месеца. Адаптираните млека за новородени са подробно описани в приложената първоначална техническа спецификация, със собствен пореден номер, описание на минималните изисквания, единична мярка и прогнозно количество. Посочените в приложената техническа спецификация видове адаптирани млека, както и прогнозните количества могат да бъдат променяни чрез добавянето на нови видове адаптирани млека или чрез промяна на прогнозните количества при възлагането на всяка конкретна обществена поръчка, в рамките на създадената ДСП. Адаптираните млека за новородени трябва да отговарят на изискванията на Закона за храните, Регламент (ЕС) № 609/2013 на Европейския парламент и на Съвета от 12 юни 2013 година относно храните, предназначени за кърмачета и малки деца, храните за специални медицински цели и заместителите на целодневния хранителен прием за регулиране на телесното тегло, Делегиран регламент (ЕС) 2016/127 на Комисията от 25 септември 2015 година за допълване на Регламент (ЕС) № 609/2013 на Европейския парламент и на Съвета по отношение на специфичните изисквания за състава и предоставянето на информация за храните за кърмачета и преходните храни и по отношение на изискванията за информация, свързана с храненето на кърмачета и малки деца и Делегиран регламент (ЕС) 2016/128 на Комисията от 25 септември 2015 година за допълване на Регламент (ЕС) № 609/2013 на Европейския парламент и на Съвета по отношение на специфичните изисквания за състава и предоставянето на информация за храните за специални медицински цели.

title: Bulgaria – Medical consumables – ДОСТАВКА НА МЕДИЦИНСКИ ИЗДЕЛИЯ НЕ ВКЛЮЧЕНИ В ЦЕНАТА НА КП, ЗАПЛАЩАНИ ОТ ПАЦИЕНТИ ЗА НУЖДИТЕ НА МБАЛ "Д-Р ТОТА ВЕНКОВА" АД ГР. ГАБРОВО
description: ДСП се създава за доставка на различни видове медицински изделия и консумативи за нуждите на МБАЛ " Д-р Тота Венкова“ АД. Първоначално планиранираната "Техническа спецификация" може да бъде частично променяна в хода на провеждане на динамичната система, като се добавят нови медицински изделия и/или консумативи и/или се променят количествата им. Посочените количества в приложената към документацията „Техническа спецификация“ са прогнозни и не пораждат задължение за Възложителя да ги възложи в прогнозния обем. Фактическото изпълнение на обществената поръчка ще се определи на базата на реално доставените медицински изделия и консумативи, в рамките на финансовия ресурс. Обменът на документи и съобщения между Възложители, кандидати, участници и изпълнители на обществени поръчки се осъществява чрез Централизираната електронна платформа. Срокът на ДСП е 36 месеца. Динамичната система за покупки е отворена през целия си срок на действие за всеки кандидат, който отговаря на критериите за подбор. Достъпът и участието в нея са свободни и безплатни за всички заинтересовани лица. Срок на договорите, сключвани въз основа на ограничените поръчки в рамките на ДСП е за период от 12 /дванадесет/ месеца. Динамичната система за покупки (ДСП) се провежда на етапи. Съгласно чл.101 от ЗОП, в зависимост от етапа на процедурата кандидатите подават заявления за участие, а квалифицираните (допуснати) кандидати - оферти. ДСП се управлява като изцяло електронен процес и през целия срок на действие на системата за покупки тя е открита за всеки стопански субект /изпълняващ орган/ИО/, който отговаря на критериите за подбор. Посочените критерии за подбор, са и критерии за изключване. Възложителят осигурява пълен, неограничен и пряк достъп до документацията по настоящата процедура чрез Централизираната електронна платформа, наричана "платформата". Заявлениятаи офертите трябва да се изготвят и представят в съответствие с изискванията на чл. 101 от ЗОП и чл.47 от ППЗОП, в срока посочен в обявлението. Всяко заявление и Всяка оферта се подава в системата на ЦАИС ЕОП Първи етап /първоначално събиране на заявления за участие/: Квалифициране на доставчиците (допускане на доставчиците до системата). На този етап се събират заявления за участие. Заявленията за участие /ЕЕДОП/ съдържа/т информация относно личното състояние на кандидатите и критериите за подбор. Краен срок за подаване на първоначални заявления - 13.06.2024 г. Разглеждането на първоначалните заявления за участие ще се извърши в срок до 10 работни дни от крайният срок за подаване на първоначални заявления. Покана за конкретна поръчка няма да бъде обявявана преди да бъдат разгледани всички първоначални заявления. Заявления могат да се подават и след крайния срок за подаване на първоначални заявления, в тези случаи кандидатите ще получават покани след одобряване на включването им в ДСП. Възложителят определя с Решение за подбор квалифицираните доставчици. След влизане в сила на Решението за подбор следва втори етап на процедурата. Втори етап /събиране на оферти по конкретни покани/: Следва изпращане на покана за представяне на оферти за конкретна обществена поръчка до тези доставчици, които са били квалифицирани/допуснати. Офертите съдържат техническо и ценово предложение. Съгласно чл.39, ал.1 от ППЗОП с подаването на оферта се счита, че кандидатите се съгласяват с всички условия на възложителя, в т.ч. с определения от него срок на валидност на офертите и с проекта на договор. Покана за конкретна поръчка няма да бъде обявявана преди да бъдат разгледани всички първоначални заявления, подадени в посоченият по-горе срок. При конкретни поръчки по покани офертите ще бъдат класирани от програма, която ще е достъпна и безплатна за всички кандидати. Осигурен е неограничен, пълен и пряк достъп до документацията за обществената поръчка през целия срок на действие на ДСП. *По всяко време заинтересовани лица могат да подават заявления за допускане/включване в ДСП. Възложителят ще разглежда новопостъпилите предложения два пъти в месеца (1-во и 15-то число на месеца) или на две седмици веднъж. Възложителят ще издава решение за допускане на кандидатите в ДСП. buyer: City of Helsinki, Urban Environment Division
title: Idea and implementation competition for Hanasaari
description: Idea and implementation competition for Hanasaari The City is organising an idea and implementation competition (hereinafter referred to as "the Competition") to find a partner for the development and implementation of the Hanasaari area. In the Competition, the Hanasaari area is divided into the following sub-areas: 1) Starting Area 2) Power Plant Area and 3) Option Areas, which are to be handed over to the Competition Winner, if the defined conditions are met. The Competition is divided into the following three phases: 1) Call for Requests to Participate Phase 2) Negotiation Phase and 3) Actual Idea and Implementation Competition. The Call for Requests to Participate is published as a procurement notice, where the project and procurement procedure for the Hanasaari area is described as well as in the description of the project and procurement procedure for the Hanasaari idea and implementation competition, which is its attachment. The procurement is governed by the Act on Public Procurement and Concession Contracts (1397/2016, hereinafter referred to as "the Procurement Act"). This is a concession contract that exceeds the threshold values, and it will be put out to tender, in accordance with the provisions of Chapter 13 of the Procurement Act. The City is inviting Competition Groups to participate in a Co-Development Procedure. In the first phase of the Co-Development Procedure, the City will publish a Call for Requests to Participate, and all Competition Groups that meet the suitability and minimum requirements set out in the Call for Requests to Participate can request to participate in it by submitting a Request to Participate. The City may not select for the Negotiation Phase of the Co-Development Procedure Competition Groups that have not submitted a request to participate or that do not meet the suitability and minimum requirements set by the City. See the procurement documents for further details.,

title: ACCESSIBLE PARKING SPACE
description: Please note this solicitation is not ready to be issued as of this date. The Embassy of the United States in Rome, Italy will launch the solicitation on the SAM.gov website when it is available. The solicitation covers the resurfacing of an accessible parking space at the U.S. Embassy in Rome, Italy. The Contractor shall furnish labor, material, and equipment to perform the work as required in the contract. This project is estimated at between $25,000 and $100,000. All responsible sources may submit a quotation, which will be considered. The Government may award the contract based on the initial offer without discussion. The resultant contract will be a firm fixed price type contract. The Government is planning a pre-quotation conference and a site visit. The date for this conference and site visit will be in the solicitation. All contractors must be registered in the SAM (System for Award Management) Database https://www.sam.gov prior to submitting an offer pursuant to FAR provision 52.204-7. Therefore, prospective offerors are encouraged to register prior to the submittal of quotation. Electronic Submission/Responses: This opportunity allows for electronic responses. Please submit your quotation prior to the response date and time. Please ensure your email with your offer does not exceed 25MB, if it does then you might have to send more than one email.

Instructions for registering are on the web page (there is no fee for registration).The solicitation and associated information will be available only from the Contract Opportunities page at SAM.gov.Your attention is directed to RFO FAR clause 52.219-14(e)(3) (DEVIATION 2021-O0008, Revision 1), LIMITATIONS ON SUBCONTRACTING, which states ?By submission of an offer and execution of a contract, the Offeror/Contractor agrees that in performance of the contract for General construction, it will not pay more than 85 percent of the amount paid by the Government for contract performance, excluding the cost of materials, to subcontractors that are not similarly situated entities. title: Next Generation Command and Control (NGC2) - Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO)
description: 17 August 2026 Update Call for Solutions (CFS) for NGC2 Scalable Software Applications closed on 6 August 2026. The Government is no longer providing the Questionnaire associated with the closed call. Please monitor SAM.gov for future opportunities. 22 July 2026 Update Call for Solutions (CFS) for NGC2 Scalable Software Applications is open for industry submittals, please submit white papers as per the instructions in the attached CFS. The due date of the parent CSO on SAM.GOV is not the due date for white paper submission. ACC C2 mailbox has been added for engagements with industry. For escalation / issues please contact Eric.J.Roberts48.civ@army.mil. _________________________________________ Command and Control (C2) is foundational to warfighting, and lessons learned from recent support to contingency operations in Ukraine and Israel, as well as threat assessments in the INDOPACOM AoR, show that the Army�s current C2 information systems should be modernized to meet commanders� needs for large scale combat operations against near peer adversaries. Current mission command systems are not mobile, intuitive, or survivable enough to easily overcome the current threat, changes in the character of warfare, and the pace of technology. As part of the Army�s continuous transformation effort, initiatives are being implemented to transform how the Army operates, trains, and equips for C2 capabilities that enhance its lethality, mobility, and survivability in large-scale combat as part of the Joint Force. The Army�s operational imperative is to improve systems responsibly, using innovative solutions from units and industry; at the same time, preparing for the future by ensuring the next generation of C2 systems are built on a portfolio of capabilities that effectively address emerging threats and ensure dominance over adversaries. The Army�s Next Generation Command and Control (NGC2) portfolio of capabilities will provide commanders with the ability to make more, better, and faster decisions through advanced analytics, an integrated data layer, open architecture, and robust and resilient transport. The result is data-centric C2 at every echelon that can operate in any environment. NGC2 requirements are currently being informed by persistent experimentation. Market research and prototyping will create a competitive environment for innovative industry partnerships and continuous integration of new technologies. Army Contracting Command- Aberdeen Proving Ground (ACC-APG) in support of the Program Executive Office Command, Control, Communications and Network (PEO C3N) and the Next Generation Command and Control (NGC2) program is publishing this Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO), W15P7T-25-S-0001, in accordance with the Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement Subpart 212.70 for the purpose of establishing a streamlined vehicle to award innovative C2 capability and functionality. This CSO will remain open until 16 May 2027. This CSO will be open until canceled by the U.S. Army. Flight Test, Telemetry and Termination (FT3) Flight Test Kit Production
description: 1. DESCRIPTION OF REQUIREMENT This is a Solicitation Synopsis issued by the Department of the Air Force, Air Force Nuclear Weapons Center (AFNWC/NIKM), Hill AFB, UT. This solicitation is for the production and delivery of flight test kit replenishment spares for the Flight Test, Telemetry, and Termination (FT3) Program. These kits directly support the Air Force Global Strike Command (AFGSC) Minuteman III (MMIII) Intercontinental Ballistic Missile (ICBM) Force Development Evaluation Operational Test Launch (OTL) Program. 2. SOLE-SOURCE JUSTIFICATION The Government intends to solicit and negotiate with only one source: The Boeing Company (CAGE: 0B0D7), located in Layton, UT, under the authority of 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1), as implemented by RFO 6.103-1 (Only One Responsible Source and No Other Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements). Market research, including a Sources Sought Synopsis (FA8214-25S-FT3PD) and Pre-solicitation Notice (FA821426RB004-PRESOL), concluded that Boeing is the only source with the unique technical data, specialized engineering expertise, and established manufacturing infrastructure required to meet the Government's strict performance schedules. Award to any other source would result in an estimated minimum duplication of $80M in costs and an unacceptable delay of at least three (3) years. 3. PROGRAM SCOPE & REQUIREMENTS The resulting contract is anticipated to be a Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) vehicle containing the following primary parameters: Quantity: Production and delivery of twenty-five (25) FT3 flight test kits. Delivery Schedule: Just-in-time delivery to Vandenberg Space Force Base, CA, precisely 120 days prior to scheduled Operational Test Launches (OTLs). Period of Performance: October 2027 through September 2035. Total Estimated Program Value: Approximately $955M (including potential future procurements executed under an approved Class J&A). 4. SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS & INTEREST This notice is not a request for competitive proposals, and a written solicitation will be issued directly to The Boeing Company. However, any responsible source that believes it can meet these requirements may submit a capability statement, proposal, or quotation, which shall be considered by the agency. Information received will be evaluated solely to determine whether to conduct a competitive procurement in the future. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed contract based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. All responses must be submitted electronically to the Points of Contact listed below no later than the Response Deadline indicated in this posting.

title: AFCENT Battle Lab Commercial Solutions Opening
description: Please Note: While SAM.gov displays a specific Inactive Date, this Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) is continuously open. Solution Briefs will be accepted and evaluated on a rolling basis at any point prior to the listed Inactive Date. Further, listed PSC and NAICS are placeholder only, final PSC and NAICS will be determined at time of propsal/award. Shaw AFB, South Carolina is conducting a CSO authorized by 10 U.S.C. 3458 and R-DFARS 212.70 and its associated class deviations. Under a CSO, the Air Force may competitively award proposals received in response to a general solicitation to acquire innovative commercial items, technologies, and services. Under this CSO, all items, technologies, and services shall be treated as commercial items. Awards will be RFO Part 12 contracts. The Air Force intends to obtain "innovative" solutions or potential new capabilities that fulfill requirements, close capability gaps, or provide potential technology advancements. Solutions may include existing technologies or procedures, not currently in use by the Air Force, that would enhance or streamline Air Force mission capabilities. �Innovative� is defined as any technology, process or method that is new as of the date of submission of a proposal. It also includes any new application of an existing technology, process, or method. The Government is not obligated to make any awards, and all awards under this CSO are explicitly subject to the availability of funds and successful negotiations. The Government is not responsible for any monies expended by any vendor prior to the issuance of any awarded contract. The Government reserves the right to modify the solicitation requirements of this CSO at its sole discretion. The Government seeks to deploy rapid, commercial off-the-shelf counter-UAS capabilities; fuse advanced intelligence and multi-source data to create a comprehensive operational picture; develop innovative kinetic and non-kinetic solutions to defeat coordinated UAS swarms; leverage agile software and rapid prototyping methodologies; implement modular open-systems approaches (MOSA) for seamless sensor integration; and establish sustainable, open-standard architectures to drive continuous competition. This enables the Department of War (DoW) to continuously field adaptable, integrated, and resilient defensive capabilities against rapidly evolving aerial and multi-domain threats. The CSO is a streamlined acquisition process that seeks to reduce acquisition timelines and acquire new, innovative solutions that vendors can bring forth to meet the stated Areas of Interest. Performers may need to demonstrate the capability to work in classified environments up to the Secret level before any award, if necessary. While this CSO is primarily designed to fulfill the requirements of the Shaw AFB Battle Lab and United States Air Forces Central (AFCENT), it may be leveraged to support broader Department of the Air Force (DAF) or Department of War (DoW) requirements under strict execution guidelines. To maintain oversight and prevent misuse, this CSO is not authorized for decentralized use by outside contracting offices. All external requirements must be validated and routed directly through AFCENT, and the 20th Contracting Squadron will retain sole procurement authority for all contract awards. Shaw AFB is focused on rapidly acquiring and deploying counter-UAS (cUAS) and defensive capabilities that form a cohesive, enterprise-wide open architecture ecosystem. The following focus areas are representative examples of the capabilities of interest; however, this is not an exhaustive list. The Government is open to, and highly encourages, innovative solutions from industry that address other technologies or approaches that align with the strategic vision outlined below. Solutions that address technologies across multiple pillars are encouraged. Teaming and Partnership for Turnkey Solutions: To mitigate the risks of disjointed systems and reduce administrative burden, the Government highly encourages industry vendors to form strategic partnerships, joint ventures, or Prime/Subcontractor teaming arrangements to submit complete, end-to-end solutions. Proposals that offer a single lead system integrator managing a suite of best-of-breed commercial technologies are strongly preferred over submissions for isolated, piecemeal components. The intent is to streamline the acquisition, delivery, and sustainment process by fielding cohesive, fully integrated systems. The Government seeks commercial capabilities that provide end-to-end defensive solutions, from immediate point defense to advanced data integration and long-term capability sustainment. Vendors may provide insight on solutions that address all or some of the capability pillars below. The desired end-state is a deployable capability that effectively counters evolving aerial threats while exploiting open architecture principles across its full lifecycle (development, integration, test, deployment, operations, and sustainment). An ideal partner has a first-party ability to directly leverage underlying commercial technologies to meet operational requirements; supporting partners would be considered enabling providers for specific aspects of the potential solution.

title: Vardø fiskerihavn – ytre molo
description: Kystverket er et forvaltningsorgan under Nærings- og fiskeridepartementet. Etaten skal bidra til sikker og effektiv ferdsel i farleder langs kysten og inn til havner, og har ansvar for statens beredskap mot akutt forurensning.Kystverket har ansvar for sikkerhet og fremkommelighet for alminnelig ferdsel i farvannet. I dette inngår ansvar for navigasjonsinfrastruktur, statlige fiskerihavneanlegg, farvannstiltak, lostjenester og sjøtrafikksentraltjenester. Kystverket har også ansvar for den nasjonale beredskapen mot akutt forurensning. Videre medvirker Kystverket i planprosesser og utøver myndighet etter havne- og farvannsloven, deler av forurensningsloven, svalbardmiljøloven og plan- og bygningsloven.Kystverket deltar også i arbeidet med Nasjonal transportplan, som fremlegges hvert fjerde år og omfatter alle de fire transportsektorene vei-, jernbane-, luft- og sjøtransport.Kystverket har en funksjonsorganisering med inndeling i fire virksomhetsområder:1) Transport, havn og farled, 2) Navigasjonsteknologi og maritime tjenester, 3) Miljøberedskap, og 4) Lostjenesten. Vardø fiskerihavn er den største fiskerihavnen i Vardø kommune og en viktig havn for fiskeflåten i Øst-Finnmark. Havnen er utsatt for betydelig bølgepåvirkning fra nordvest til nordøst, noe som medfører krevende liggeforhold, økt risiko for skader på fartøy og infrastruktur, samt begrensninger for effektiv bruk av havneanlegget.Prosjektet omfatter etablering av en ny ytre molo nord for innseilingen til Vardø havn, samt utdyping ved Hasselneset for å sikre tilfredsstillende framkommelighet etter at innseilingen innsnevres som følge av den nye moloen. Moloen får en total lengde på om lag 660 meter og bygges på vanndybder ned mot 35 meter.Utdypingen ved Hasselneset omfatter både mudring av løsmasser og undervannssprengning av berg, med et samlet volum på om lag 45 000 m³. Massene fra utdypingen skal gjenbrukes i molokonstruksjonen.Store deler av arbeidene skal utføres fra sjøen ved hjelp av en midlertidig anleggsøy. Alle eksterne steinmasser til molobyggingen skal transporteres sjøveien. Prosjektet er derfor i stor grad avhengig av sjøbasert logistikk, spesialisert utstyr og gjennomføring under krevende vær- og bølgeforhold.Prosjektet er underlagt omfattende miljøkrav og flere offentlige tillatelser, blant annet knyttet til arbeid i sjø, mudring, undervannssprengning, miljøovervåking og plastregnskap. Videre er prosjektet underlagt sesongmessige restriksjoner for deler av arbeidene.Prosjektets primære mål er å forbedre roligheten og sikkerheten i Vardø fiskerihavn, legge til rette for effektiv og trygg havnedrift og bidra til videre utvikling av fiskeri- og sjørelaterte næringer i området.

Hankinnan kohteena dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän sisällä ovat HUS-yhtymän yksiköissä tarvittavat terveydenhuollon kalusteet. HUS pyrkii tällä dynaamisella hankintajärjestelmällä hankkimaan sellaisia terveydenhuollon kalusteita, joita ei ole huomioitu tällä hetkellä voimassa olevissasopimuksissa tai tarve ilmenee uutena HUSin rakennushankkeiden myötä. Hankittavat terveydenhuollon kalusteet voivat olla esimerkiksi osastoilla, poliklinikoilla, saleissa, potilas- tai henkilökuntatiloissa, laitoshuollon tai puhtaanapidon tiloissa käytettäviä kalusteita. title: Repair Maintenance Hangar Facility Building 253 PSTE 172022
description: *ANNOUNCEMENT* This is a commercial service construction project in accordance with E.O.14271The USPFO for South Carolina intends to issue an Invitation for Bid to award a single firm fixed- price contract for services, non-personal, to provide all plant, labor, transportation, materials, tools, equipment, appliances, and supervision necessary to repair and expand airfield pavements to meet standard by utilizing conventional design and construction methods at McEntire JNGB. The scope of this project will consist of for adequate and efficient indoor workspace to maintain assigned and transient aircraft and provide organizational, administrative, component repair, logistical, tool storage, meeting, classroom, and other spaces. Work includes construction upgrades to the existing 65,000+ SF facility. Facility currently consists of hangar space, maintenance space, administrative, training, and storage spaces. Existing windows will be replaced throughout the facility with new energy efficient windows. Existing roof will be removed and replaced. The existing bi-parting sliding main hangar doors are to be removed and replaced with new doors. The existing unidirectional sliding Phase Dock hangar door is to be refurbished and receive new exterior skin. The existing facility shall be upgraded with new plumbing, mechanical, electrical, and fire protection systems with an emphasis on energy efficiency and conservation. The work is located at McEntire Joint National Guard Base near Eastover in Richland County, South Carolina. The award is anticipated to consist of the following line items (CLINs): CLIN 0001: Base Bid, in addition to the base work described above, the solicitation will include the following optional line items: CLIN 0002: Bid Option 1A: Eastern hangar trench drain and sewer modification, CLIN 0003: Bid Option 1B: Western hangar trench drain modification, CLIN 0004: Bid Option 2: Remove and replace existing generator, and CLIN 0005: Bid Option 3: Maintain temporary facilities through Phase 2. This project is set aside 100% for Small Business. The North American Industry Classification (NAICS) Code is 236220, with a size standard of $45,000,000.00. The magnitude of the project is between $10,000,000.00 and $25,000,000.00. The project is anticipated to occur in two phases with a total contract duration of 550 days after notice to proceed (NTP). The first phase includes demolition and renovations to the main hangar, shops opening to the rear of the main hangar, and the second floor organizational and admin space. The second phase includes renovations to the Phase Dock Hangar, the Fabrication Shop, and the Tire Room. No work shall begin on phase two until the government has fully accepted stage one and issued a separate NTP (this may not start immediately following stage one completion). *NOTE: If option(s) are unilaterally exercised within the timeframe noted in FAR 52.217-7 they shall be completed during performance of the base bid construction and will not extend total period of performance. Your attention is directed to FAR Clause 52.219-14(e)(3) (DEVIATION 2021-O0008), LIMITATIONS ON SUBCONTRACTING, which states ?By submission of an offer and execution of a contract, the Contractor agrees that in performance of a contract assigned a North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for General construction, it will not pay more than 85 percent of the amount paid by the Government for contract performance, excluding the cost of materials, to subcontractors that are not similarly situated entities. Any work that a similarly situated entity further subcontracts will count towards the prime contractor?s 85 percent subcontract amount that cannot be exceeded?. In accordance with FAR 36.211(b), the following information is provided:(1) The National Guard has no agency-specific policies or procedures applicable to definitization of equitable adjustments for change orders under construction contracts other than those described at FAR 43.204, DFARS 243.204 and AFARS 5143.204.(2) Data for the prior 3 fiscal years regarding the time required to definitize equitable adjustments for change orders under construction contracts for the National Guard is currently not available but will be compiled and provided in future announcements. Prospective bidders are highly encouraged to attend a pre-bid conference and site visit: See Section 00 21 00 - Instructions, paragraph 3 of solicitation for time and date, at McEntire Joint National Guard Base 169th FW, CE Conference Room, 1325 South Carolina Road, Building 1071, Eastover, SC 29044. Interested contractors shall follow conference registration and base access requirements shown in the solicitation. A site visit will follow the pre-bid conference. All questions for the pre-bid conference must be submitted 5 calendar days prior to the conference via email to jonathan.bailey.28@us.af.mil and badri.francis.1@us.af.mil. Submit Proposals no later than: See Box 13 and any amendments for Proposal Due Date. Interested offerors must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM). To register go to www.sam.gov. Instructions for registering are on the web page (there is no fee for registration). The solicitation and associated information and the plans and specifications will be available only from the Contract Opportunities page at SAM.gov. DISCLAIMER: The official plans and specifications are located on the official government webpage, and the Government is not liable for information furnished by any other source. Amendments, if/when issued will be posted to Contract Opportunities for electronic downloading. This will normally be the only method of distributing amendments prior to closing; therefore, it is the offeror?s responsibility to check the website periodically for any amendments to the solicitation. title: Bulgaria – Pharmaceutical products – „Доставка на лекарствени продукти, които са включени в Приложение 2 на ПЛС, за нуждите на УМБАЛ „КАНЕВ“ АД“
description: ДСП се създава за периодична доставка по предварителна заявка на лекарствени продукти, които са включени в Приложение 2 на ПЛС, необходими за изпълнение на лечебната дейност в УМБАЛ „КАНЕВ” АД. Лекарствените продукти, предмет на процедурата са представени в първоначална "Техническа спецификация“ /част от документацията за участие/, с посочени лекарствени форми, количество лекарствено вещество, единица мярка и необходимо прогнозно количество. Първоначално планиранираната "Техническа спецификация" може да бъде частично променяна в хода на провеждане на динамичната система, като се добавят нови лекарствени продукти и/или се променят количествата им. Посочените количества в приложената към настоящите указания „Техническа спецификация“ са прогнозни и не пораждат задължение за Възложителя да ги възложи в прогнозния обем. Кандидатите, включени в ДСП могат да подадат оферта за един или повече редове, както и могат да не подадат оферта. ДСП ще функционира в рамките на 36 /тридесет и шест/ месеца, като в този период Възложителят може да отправя покани до включените в ДСП кандидати за събиране на оферти за всяка конкретна поръчка за доставка на лекарствени продукти, в рамките на ДСП. Срок на договорите, сключвани въз основа на ограничените поръчки в рамките на ДСП е за период от 24 месеца. ДСП функционира на два етапа, както следва: ПЪРВИ ЕТАП НА ДИНАМИЧНАТА СИСТЕМА ЗА ПОКУПКИ – СЪБИРАНЕ НА ЗАЯВЛЕНИЯ ЗА УЧАСТИЕ: Квалифициране на доставчиците (допускане на доставчиците до системата). На този етап се събират заявления за участие в ДСП. Заявленията за участие /ЕЕДОП/ съдържат информация относно личното състояние на кандидатите и критериите за подбор, поставени от Възложителя. Краен срок за подаване на първоначални заявления - 27.05.2024 г. Разглеждането на първоначалните заявления за участие се извършва в срок до 10 /десет/ работни дни от крайният срок за подаване на първоначални заявления, след което Възложителят определя с решение за подбор с което квалифицираните доставчици се включват в ДСП. След първоначалния срок за подаване на заявления, Възложителят ще разглежда новопостъпилите заявления два пъти в месеца /всеки понеделник от първата и третата седмица на месеца/. След всяко разглеждане на заявленията, Възложителят издава решение за подбор. След влизане в сила на решението за подбор следва втори етап на процедурата. ВТОРИ ЕТАП НА ДИНАМИЧНАТА СИСТЕМА ЗА ПОКУПКИ – СЪБИРАНЕ НА ОФЕРТИ ПО КОНКРЕТНИ ПОКАНИ: След влизане в сила на първоначалното решение за включване на одобрените кандидатите в ДСП, Възложителят обявява отделни процедури в рамките на ДСП. За всяка конкретна процедура, Възложителят изпраща покана за представяне на оферти за конкретната поръчка до всички кандидати, включени в ДСП. Офертите на кандидатите съдържат техническо и ценово предложение. Офертите ще бъдат класирани от програма, която ще бъде достъпна и безплатна за участниците.

title: Levee Repair at MRLS L246
description: PRESOLICITATION NOTICE The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Kansas City District, anticipates issuing a solicitation and awarding a single contract for construction services to repair the levee at MRLS L246. The Government intends to award a Firm-Fixed Price (FFP) contract for this project. This will be a 100% Small Business Set-Aside competitive acquisition.The work covered by this contract consist of furnishing all equipment, labor, operators, supervision/site superintendent, quality control, supplies, materials, and incidentals necessary to satisfactorily perform and provide construction to potentially include, but not limited to earthwork operations, bringing in fill and borrow material from a pre-determined site, haul road development, clearing of debris as necessary, erosion repair, rutting repair, levee surfacing, various stone surfacing/placement, installation of stone armored protection, installation and rehabilitation of drainage structures and associated apertures, and establishment of turf for repairs of compromised landside, riverside, and crown levee sections. Currently, a Pre-Solicitation Conference is not scheduled. If the Government decides to hold a conference, this announcement will be amended accordingly. A site visit is planned for this solicitation. Details regarding the date, time, and location will be provided within the solicitation. Any changes to the site visit schedule will be communicated in the solicitation or through subsequent amendments, as applicable. No options are currently identified for this project. The estimated magnitude of this construction project is between $1,000,000 and $5,000,000. The solicitation will be issued as an Invitation for Bid (IFB), open to all Small Businesses. Submission requirements and evaluation criteria will be detailed in the solicitation. The IFB will result in the award of a single Firm-Fixed Price (FFP) construction contract. The estimated performance period for completing construction is approximately 365 calendar days from the Notice to Proceed (NTP). A bid bond will be required with your proposal, amounting to 20% of the offerors proposed price or $3,000,000.00, whichever is less. Performance and Payment Bonds will be required for the full amount (100%) of the awarded contract before the Notice to Proceed can be issued. Bids will be due on the date and time specified in the solicitation. We anticipate releasing the solicitation within the next 60 days. To avoid missing this notice, contractors are encouraged to register as interested vendors. By registering, you will be automatically notified of any changes to this notice, including the posting of the solicitation. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this project is 237990, with a size standard of $45,000,000.00. The solicitation will be open to all Small Businesses. Prior to submitting a proposal/bid, vendors must be actively registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) system and the Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE). These systems are Federal Government-owned and operated websites, accessible free of charge. All vendors must verify their information on these websites. Accessing and downloading the solicitation requires registration on both the SAM.gov website at https://sam.gov/ and the PIEE website at https://wawf.eb.mil/ . Downloads and instructions are available on these websites. Amendments will only be available on the PIEE website. title: Repair Maintenance Hangar Facility Building 253 PSTE 172022
description: *ANNOUNCEMENT* This is a commercial service construction project in accordance with E.O.14271The USPFO for South Carolina intends to issue an Invitation for Bid to award a single firm fixed- price contract for services, non-personal, to provide all plant, labor, transportation, materials, tools, equipment, appliances, and supervision necessary to repair maintenance hangar to meet standard by utilizing conventional design and construction methods at McEntire JNGB. The scope of this project will consist of for adequate and efficient indoor workspace to maintain assigned and transient aircraft and provide organizational, administrative, component repair, logistical, tool storage, meeting, classroom, and other spaces. Work includes construction upgrades to the existing 65,000+ SF facility. Facility currently consists of hangar space, maintenance space, administrative, training, and storage spaces. Existing windows will be replaced throughout the facility with new energy efficient windows. Existing roof will be removed and replaced. The existing bi-parting sliding main hangar doors are to be removed and replaced with new doors. The existing unidirectional sliding Phase Dock hangar door is to be refurbished and receive new exterior skin. The existing facility shall be upgraded with new plumbing, mechanical, electrical, and fire protection systems with an emphasis on energy efficiency and conservation. The work is located at McEntire Joint National Guard Base near Eastover in Richland County, South Carolina. The award is anticipated to consist of the following line items (CLINs): CLIN 0001: Base Bid, in addition to the base work described above, the solicitation will include the following optional line items: CLIN 0002: Bid Option 1A: Eastern hangar trench drain and sewer modification, CLIN 0003: Bid Option 1B: Western hangar trench drain modification, CLIN 0004: Bid Option 2: Remove and replace existing generator, and CLIN 0005: Bid Option 3: Maintain temporary facilities through Phase 2. This project is set aside 100% for Small Business. The North American Industry Classification (NAICS) Code is 236220, with a size standard of $45,000,000.00. The magnitude of the project is between $10,000,000.00 and $25,000,000.00. The project is anticipated to occur in two phases with a total contract duration of 550 days after notice to proceed (NTP). The first phase includes demolition and renovations to the main hangar, shops opening to the rear of the main hangar, and the second floor organizational and admin space. The second phase includes renovations to the Phase Dock Hangar, the Fabrication Shop, and the Tire Room. No work shall begin on phase two until the government has fully accepted stage one and issued a separate NTP (this may not start immediately following stage one completion). *NOTE: If option(s) are unilaterally exercised within the timeframe noted in FAR 52.217-7 they shall be completed during performance of the base bid construction and will not extend total period of performance. Your attention is directed to FAR Clause 52.219-14(e)(3) (DEVIATION 2021-O0008), LIMITATIONS ON SUBCONTRACTING, which states ?By submission of an offer and execution of a contract, the Contractor agrees that in performance of a contract assigned a North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for General construction, it will not pay more than 85 percent of the amount paid by the Government for contract performance, excluding the cost of materials, to subcontractors that are not similarly situated entities. Any work that a similarly situated entity further subcontracts will count towards the prime contractor?s 85 percent subcontract amount that cannot be exceeded?. In accordance with FAR 36.211(b), the following information is provided:(1) The National Guard has no agency-specific policies or procedures applicable to definitization of equitable adjustments for change orders under construction contracts other than those described at FAR 43.204, DFARS 243.204 and AFARS 5143.204.(2) Data for the prior 3 fiscal years regarding the time required to definitize equitable adjustments for change orders under construction contracts for the National Guard is currently not available but will be compiled and provided in future announcements. title: Switzerland – Construction work for bridges and tunnels, shafts and subways – AS35 Zürich Stadelhofen Anlagenerweiterung, Projektteil 30101 GU Rohbau Zürichberg-, Riesbach-, ​Perrontunnel und Tiefenbrunnen
description: Dans le projet EA 2035 Zürich Stadelhofen Extension des installations, la Confédération et les CFF prévoient d’aménager la gare Zürich Stadelhofen en intégrant une quatrième voie et des raccordements vers la gare centrale de Zurich, vers Stettbach et vers Zürich Tiefenbrunnen, ainsi que de nouveaux tunnels à simple voie. Le projet est structuré en quatre sections. - Section 1: priorité - Section 2: gare Stadelhofen - Section 3: tunnel et tranchée Tiefenbrunnen - Section 4: technique ferroviaire Les principaux travaux de gros œuvre sont subdivisés à leur tour en quatre projets partiels de gros œuvre (PP). Ils seront publiés séparément comme suit: - PP 20101 Gare Stadelhofen - PP 20102 Paroi de pieux forés et galerie d’ancrage - PP 30101 Tunnel du Zürichberg, tunnel de Riesbach, tunnel de quai et Tiefenbrunnen - PP 30102 2. Tunnel du Hirschengraben Le présent appel d’offres se rapporte à la partie de projet 30101 du section 3 et à des parties du section 2; elle intègre le gros œuvre du nouveau tunnel de quai et de la halle voûtée, de la bifurcation souterraine constituant la limite sud avec poursuite via le 2e tunnel du Riesbach et le 2e tunnel du Zürichberg, y compris celui de divers ouvrages annexes et de la zone ouverte à Tiefenbrunnen (tranchée d’accès et double voie jusqu’à la gare de Tiefenbrunnen); elle englobe en outre les parties d’installation des sections 2 et 3. Les travaux de raccordement au nord, en direction de la gare centrale de Zurich (2e tunnel du Hirschengraben), ceux de la zone de la gare de Stadelhofen ainsi que ceux des ouvrages annexes y relatifs feront l’objet d’un avis préalable ou d’un appel d’offres séparé. La nouvelle quatrième voie pour la gare de Stadelhofen se situe dans un tunnel de quai d’une longueur de 335 m, env. 40 m en arrière de la gare existante, au même niveau que l’actuelle galerie marchande. La liaison avec cette dernière passe par la halle voûtée. L’ouvrage de bifurcation constituant la limite sud pour le 2e tunnel de Riesbach s’étend sur env. 180 m jusqu’au début des deux nouveaux tunnels à simple voie au niveau du puits de construction Kreuzbühlwiese (diamètre d’env. 20 m, profondeur d’env. 33 m). Ce faisant, l’ouvrage de bifurcation croise le puits Hohenbühlstrasse (également diamètre d’env. 20 m, profondeur d’env. 33 m) qui, à l’état achevé, servira de centrale de ventilation incendie. Le 2e tunnel du Zürichberg d’une longueur de 306 m est raccordé par un ouvrage correspondant, en direction de Stettbach, env. 200 m à l’est de la sortie de secours existante St. Antonius, au tunnel du Zürichberg existant. Le 2e tunnel creusé de Riesbach d’une longueur de 1367 m part de l’ouvrage de bifurcation en direction de Tiefenbrunnen. Il passe en dessous du tunnel du Zürichberg existant et débouche en surface à côté du portail du tunnel de Riesbach existant. Adjacent à l’ouvrage de portail, avec un tunnel en tranchée ouverte d’env. 32 m de long, la tranchée d’accès jusqu’à la gare de Zürich Tiefenbrunnen sera élargie à deux voies et le passage à niveau de la Seefeldstrasse sera adapté en conséquence. La sécurité dans les nouveaux tunnels est assurée par une nouvelle sortie de secours à Neumünster (diamètre de 11 m, profondeur d’env. 43 m), incluant une galerie d’évacuation et de secours depuis le nouveau tunnel et le tunnel existant de Riesbach (longueur totale de la galerie d’env. 170 m), par la nouvelle galerie d’évacuation St. Antonius (longueur de la galerie d’env. 190 m) ainsi que par l’adaptation et l’extension des actuelles installations. Un complément d’information est proposé sur la page officielle du projet: Ausbau Zürich Stadelhofen SBB <https://company.sbb.ch/de/bahnentwicklung/projekte/deutschschweiz/region-zuerich/ausbau-zuerich-stadelhofen.html> (Aménagement Zürich Stadelhofen CFF) Le système de tunnels sera construit à l’aide d’engins, depuis le puits de chantier de Kreuzbühlwiese et depuis le portail de Tiefenbrunnen. Le puits de sortie de secours et le système de galeries à Neumünster seront réalisés à partir de Neumünster. Une installation temporaire de chargement des matériaux sera aménagée à la gare de Zürich Tiefenbrunnen. Les quantités approximatives nécessaires à la construction de l’installation de tunnel complète (partie de projet 30101) sont les suivantes: - Déblai (roche et matériau meuble): 420 000 m3 compacts - Béton (coulé sur place et projeté): 300 000 m3 - Armature: 22 000 t - Enceintes de fouilles * Parois clouées: 3800 m2 * Parois de pieux: 4900 m2 * Parois berlinoises: 3200 m2 - Tirant d’ancrage: * Ancrage non contraint: - Travaux souterrains: 36 000 m - Fouilles: 1400 m * Ancrage contraint (fouilles): 15 000 m - Voûte parapluie: 35 000 m (longueur du tube) Le début des travaux est prévu en 2028 et une période de construction principale d’environ 7,5 ans est mise à disposition pour le travail en tunnel. Une phase AVOR avant le lancement des travaux de construction est prise en compte. Pour la partie de projet 30101, les CFF recherchent un entrepreneur général (EG) chargé du gros œuvre et de la tranchée d’accès, c’est-à-dire principalement pour les prestations suivantes: travaux de génie civil spéciaux, génie civil et construction du tunnel, y compris évacuation et mise en décharge des matériaux de percement. Il sera confié à cet EG de gros œuvre la seule construction des ouvrages (gros œuvre) et celui-ci se portera garant des coûts, des délais et de la qualité requise, hors technique ferroviaire et hors équipement. L’appel d’offres implique un contrat à prix unitaire incluant l’utilisation du catalogue CAN. Dans le cadre de l’exécution, les planificateurs mandatés par les CFF réalisent la planification et l’étude de projet. Les documents d’appel d’offres et, ultérieurement, les plans d’exécution sont mis à disposition de façon conventionnelle (plan 2D). description: Dinamikus beszerzési rendszer (DBR) létrehozása laboratóriumi szolgáltatások biztosítására az alábbi főbb kategóriákban: I. Állati -, állati eredetű minták és trágya vizsgálata II. Növényi minták (növényből, növényi anyagból, növényi alapú termékből származó minták) vizsgálata III. Vízvizsgálatok IV. Talaj és környezeti minták vizsgálata V. Molekuláris és biotechnológiai eljárások Felhívjuk a figyelmet, hogy a főbb kategóriák kizárólag tájékoztatás céljával kerültek felsorolásra a beszerzés volumenének felmérése érdekében, AK az egyes kategóriákon belül a felmerülő igényeknek megfelelően a beszerezni kívánt szolgáltatás(ok) pontos műszaki leírását és szerződéses feltételeit a DBR-ben részt vevők számára a DBR ajánlattételi szakaszaiban, az ajánlattételi felhívás megküldésével egyidejűleg bocsátja rendelkezésre a Kbt. 107. § (2) bekezdése alapján. Ajánlatkérő a Kbt.107. § (2) bekezdése alapján fenntartja annak a lehetőségét, hogy a DBR megvalósítása során, az ajánlattételi felhívás megküldésével egyidejűleg, az abban foglalt konkrét beszerzési igényre vonatkozóan - a konkrét közbeszerzések tárgyától és jellegétől függően - részajánlattételi lehetőséget határozzon meg az ajánlattételi felhívásban. Ajánlatkérő a DBR-t 30 hónapra kívánja létrehozni, mely időszakra tervezett beszerzések összértéke nettó 100 000 000,-Ft. AK nem vállal megrendelési kötelezettséget az eljárást megindító felhívásban foglalt becsült összérték tekintetében. AK a felmerült igényei szerint tervezetten havonta kíván egy ajánlattételi szakaszt indítani, fenntartva a jogot, hogy ettől gyakrabban és ritkábban is küldjön ajánlattételi felhívást. A DBR-ben odaítélendő egyes szerződések várható maximális nagyságrendje szerződésenként nettó 20 000 000,-Ft, a szerződések várható átlagos nagyságrendje szerződésenként nettó 1.000.000,- Ft, a szerződések várható minimális nagyságrendje szerződésenként nettó 700.000,- Ft. Egyenértékűség: A közbeszerzési eljárás műszaki leírásában és egyéb dokumentumaiban meghatározott gyártmányú vagy eredetű dologra, illetve konkrét eljárásra, amely egy adott gazdasági szereplő termékeit vagy az általa nyújtott szolgáltatásokat jellemzi, vagy védjegyre, szabadalomra, tevékenységre, személyre, típusra vagy adott származásra vagy gyártási folyamatra történő utalás esetén az ilyen jellegű megnevezés mellé a „vagy azzal egyenértékű” kifejezést is oda kell érteni. A meghatározott gyártmányú vagy eredetű dologra, illetve konkrét eljárásra, amely egy adott gazdasági szereplő termékeit vagy az általa nyújtott szolgáltatásokat jellemzi, vagy védjegyre, szabadalomra, tevékenységre, személyre, típusra vagy adott származásra vagy gyártási folyamatra való utalás ugyancsak a tárgy egyértelmű beazonosítását szolgálja, az ajánlatkérő ezekkel egyenértékű minőség biztosítása érdekében tett intézkedéseket is elfogad. A közbeszerzési eljárás műszaki leírásában és egyéb dokumentumaiban a meghatározott szabvány, műszaki engedély, műszaki előírások, műszaki ajánlás megnevezése mellé a "vagy azzal egyenértékű" kifejezést is oda kell érteni. Nem nyilvánítható érvénytelennek az ajánlat kizárólag azon az alapon, hogy az ajánlatban szereplő építési beruházások, termékek vagy szolgáltatások nem felelnek meg a műszaki leírásnak, ha az ajánlattevő ajánlatában megfelelő módon, bármely megfelelő eszközzel bizonyítja, hogy az általa javasolt megoldások egyenértékű módon megfelelnek a közbeszerzési műszaki leírásban meghatározott követelményeknek. Egyenértékű típus megajánlása esetén az egyenértékűséget az ajánlattevő ajánlatában megfelelő módon, bármely megfelelő eszközzel kell bizonyítsa, hogy az általa javasolt megoldások egyenértékű módon megfelelnek a közbeszerzési műszaki leírásban meghatározott követelményeknek. [321/2015. (X.30.) Korm. rendelet 46. § (3)-(6) bekezdés]. A DBR, mint sajátos beszerzési módszer alkalmazásának indoka, hogy a konkrét beszerzési igények felmerülésének időpontja és pontos mennyisége ajánlatkérő számára nem határozható meg előre a Kbt. által elvárt részletezettséggel, ugyanakkor a tervezett beszerzések volumenéből következtetve - a Kbt. 19.§ (1)-(3) bekezdése alapján - a közbeszerzési kötelezettség fennáll. Ajánlatkérő a DBR-ben megvalósítandó konkrét közbeszerzésre vonatkozó pontos műszaki leírást és szerződéses feltételeket a DBR-ben részt vevők számára, az ajánlattételi szakaszban, az ajánlattételi felhívás megküldésével egyidejűleg bocsátja rendelkezésre. A felkért ajánlattevők ennek birtokában, az ajánlattételi szakaszban teszik meg az ajánlatukat. Mindemellett a beszerzési igények előre nem tervezhetők, és teljes körűen nem mérhetők fel, mivel azok tárgya és mennyisége a tényleges igények felmerülésével alakul és válik ismertté, ebből következően a részajánlattételi lehetőségek sem határozhatók meg előzetesen. Felhívjuk Tisztelt Részvételre jelentkezők figyelmét, hogy Ajánlatkérő a DBR-be felvett jelentkezőkkel részvételi szakaszban, a részvételre vonatkozó szerződést nem köt.

description: Mississippi River, Baton Rouge to the Gulf, Saltwater Barrier Sill, Cutterhead Dredge Contract No. 1-2025. Specification No. OM25135 The Contractor's dredge and attendant plant will primarily be used in connection with the construction and possible maintenance of a saltwater barrier sill located between Mile 63.0 and Mile 64.0 Above Head of Passes (AHP) on the Mississippi. The work will consist of satisfactorily placing hydraulically dredged material which shall be taken from a borrow area located on the river bottom.
